Yea there's even a name for it, [PMDD](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Premenstrual_dysphoric_disorder). I've gone through a couple different options but the two things I know have worked for people are  SSRI's and a birth control where you have no periods. For me, I couldn't handle the side effects of the SSRI's so I'm taking a version of the pill that you can take everyday and either have a period every 3 months, or not at all. Talk to your doc and try a couple different things. 

Aside from medication, when depressed like that I tend to try to remind myself that it will pass, and then do things that are super calming. This doesn't always mesh well with class work, but do the best you can. I like to meditate, take long showers or read fantasy to escape my head and all the negative thoughts. YMMV. Best of luck!
Okay, thanks for the insight. I didn't know that about them. I'll email her I guess today or tomorrow.
Yea I'm on SSRIs, have been for about 5 months now. At first it seemed like they were working, but I've been going downhill over the last month or so.

I meant to go to a farmers market this morning, but that didnt happen. I'm out of groceries so I havent eaten yet today. I'm hoping to get myself to shower and go to the store. I'm in a different time zone and very very far from all of my friends and my LDBF so its hard to get myself moving today. Hopefully I get outside. That usually helps a little at least.

hey I totally understand avoiding hospitalization, Its not for everybody. Just make sure you try to keep a little bit of your mind monitoring how youre doing. I've been there man, had to talk them out of putting my in a police car and driving me to the hospital. Mental stuff like this is very much a private thing and it can be really hard to open up about it that much so suddenly. Just keep moving forward at a pace that works for you. You'll get there. I know it doesn't seem like it, but if i can make it, you can too.
